name: io.github.open-deltat/deltat
description: Give an agent a calendar it can book without double-booking: find, hold, then commit atomically.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the deltat server. Required; there is no default.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAT_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Tenant to connect to. Each database name is an isolated tenant.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAT_TLS
environmentVariables.description: on to encrypt the connection and verify deltat's certificate. Unset means off unless DELTAT_TLS_CA is set; without TLS the password is sent in the clear, so use it for any deltat that is not on this machine.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAT_TLS_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM certificate to trust instead of the system's authorities, for a deltat with a self-signed certificate. Implies DELTAT_TLS=on.
